criteria.statement: The artifact's encoding field names the shipped format, and the loader reads that field rather than assuming one
The committed artifact is measurably smaller: from 5.650 MB (float32-base64) to about 1.442 MB (int8)
Tracked apps/backend/data total drops from the 2026-09-05 measurement of 118.095 MB; the new figure and headroom are recorded in NFR-017
Retrieval quality does not regress after the format change: benchmark clean recall@5 at or above the value REQ-182 records, polluted recall@5 likewise, all 12 labelled fixture checks still pass
The vector-loading path degrades exactly as REQ-181 requires: missing, malformed, or unrecognised-encoding disables the semantic path with one diagnostic warning and falls back to lexical
node --test scripts/lambda-package-budget.test.mjs passes with the new artifact, and the test's recorded figures are updated in the same change
MIN_VARIANT_POPULARITY stays at 0 (combo corpus not trimmed) and no new dependency or external service is introduced
The REQ-183 and NFR-017 documentation blocks are applied by intent, matching the finalized GATE-QUESTIONS.md diff (including the owner's CI/CUDA edit)
